rules: values are FAO CALENDAR years, not split crop seasons; yield is derived as production / area
areas are matched on FAO's numeric codes, never the display name (accents break names)
areas_rule: every area whose UN M49 code (FAOSTAT column 'Area Code (M49)') is a current ISO 3166 numeric code in the country reference (ref_countries) is that country; FAO area 5000 (World) is 'WLD'; everything else — regional aggregates, 'China' (M49 159, which re-adds Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao), former states such as 'Sudan (former)' — is not a country and is not read (E151; until then a hand list of 35 areas)
